entries.note: Lowest is coverage: only 10 claims from 39 kept papers, no OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions or SWE-agent trajectory sources used though SWE-agent was retrieved; also a sentence cites R12 with no citation, and the Tracezip claim says sampling forces a trade-off while its quote only says existing work faces one.

Lowest is reproducibility: no retrieved.jsonl is saved for this run, so the 120 candidates and the 31 kept cannot be inspected; the review also says CLM reports FLOPs not wall-clock while the CLM paper reports 65% greater end-to-end speedup, and one sentence (RLM comparable cost on long-context) is uncited.

Lowest is answers_question: only Claude Code is covered on storage; Aider and Codex CLI are unaddressed, no cross-harness comparison of granularity or commit history is made, and the vector-database part is answered by one source; the review does admit these gaps.
